metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the opening of term, a thin Fair Em, and the garden sheet.

yesterday: Trinity term is open. The almanac says so, and the yard felt it.
Fair Em was thin. Watchmen at the gate looked at faces. The Rose, by Raye, was thinner, and the title was Antony and Valia.
The garden is written: apricocks, weeds, caterpillars, pruning, and the queen's curse. Thirty-odd lines. The gardener is right. The deposing sits behind that sheet.
You stopped on the garden sheet.
